title: Cipanas Palace
geometryBasis: The 12-vertex standing palace way names Gedung Induk Istana Kepresidenan Cipanas, matches Wikidata Q12486833 and aligns the projecting entrance with the documented front lawn. This is the original main residence rather than a neighboring pavilion.
sectionBasis: The State Secretariat describes the surviving main building’s front and rear verandas, broad glazed side screens, teak and iron structure and blend of tropical West Javanese and European architecture. The Rijksmuseum’s c.1844–46 study depicts the raised front and historical roof profile. The estate guide describes 11 approach steps and the provincial government records a floor raise of about two meters.
limitations: Exterior reconstruction. Exact roof angles, exterior window spacing, ridge and porch details, glazing and rear elevations are approximate. The original mid-nineteenth-century drawing establishes the broad historic form.
Covers the main residence only. Gedung Bentol, the pavilions, the baths, landscaped grounds and interiors are outside this model.
